**Mi Band 7 / 8 / 9:** use `mi-band-192x490.png` as the background and put the clock inside
the screen: x 46, y 109, 101 × 127 px.

## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.4499 (spec 0.45), screen at the exact 128:160 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://www.esato.com/gfx/phones/sonyericssont270.jpg (press render)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://gsm.magazyn.pl/pic/b/sony-ericsson-t270.jpg); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/t270i/), [devicebeast.com](https://devicebeast.com/phones/t270).
